design_gotchas.title: Large Minimum Ceramic Output Capacitance (44 uF Min / 66 uF Recommended)
design_gotchas.detail: Because TPS63020 operates at 2.4 MHz with 4 A switch capability in boost/buck-boost transitions, TI specifies a minimum of 2 x 22 uF (44 uF nominal) and recommends 3 x 22 uF (66 uF) low-ESR ceramic output capacitors. Accounting for DC bias derating is mandatory to avoid boost-mode instability.

design_gotchas.title: Unique VSON-14 (DSJ) Footprint With 8 Edge PGND Tabs Cannot Drop Into VSON-10
design_gotchas.detail: TPS63020DSJR uses a 3 mm x 4 mm 14-pin VSON package with a large exposed center pad plus 8 perimeter PGND ground tabs (RthetaJA = 41.8°C/W). It is completely pin- and footprint-incompatible with 10-pin VSON TPS63001DRCR or 6-pin SOT-563 TPS61023DRLR.

design_gotchas.title: EN and PS/SYNC Must Never Float; Separate VINA Filtering Recommended
design_gotchas.detail: Neither EN (Pin 12) nor PS/SYNC (Pin 13) has internal pull resistors and must be actively driven or tied to VINA/GND. Feed VINA (Pin 1) with a dedicated 0.1 uF bypass capacitor (and optional 10-100 Ohm series resistor) to isolate control logic from VIN switching spikes.

design_gotchas.title: Output Current Drops From 3 A (Buck) to ~2 A (Boost) as Battery Discharges
design_gotchas.detail: Although rated up to 3 A in step-down mode, deliverable output current at VOUT = 3.3 V falls to > 2 A at VIN = 2.5 V and lower near 1.8 V due to the 4 A average switch current limit and boost duty cycle.

typical_use_cases: Single-cell Li-Ion (2.5 V to 4.2 V) or 2-3 cell alkaline battery regulation to 3.3 V at > 2 A continuous load
Cellular/LTE-M/NB-IoT RF modem and industrial handheld power rails requiring seamless buck-to-boost transition
High-current compact 5.0 V or 3.3 V USB-powered systems needing PG supervision and external clock sync
engineering_summary: The TPS63020DSJR is a high-efficiency, high-current 4-switch synchronous buck-boost converter in a thermally enhanced 14-pin VSON (DSJ) package (RthetaJA = 41.8°C/W) with an integrated 4 A average switch limit. It regulates adjustable 1.2 V to 5.5 V outputs (VREF = 0.500 V) from 1.8 V to 5.5 V inputs at 2.4 MHz, delivering up to 3 A in step-down mode and > 2 A in boost mode (3.3 V out, VIN > 2.5 V) with true load disconnect and Power Good output. Always size ceramic output capacitance >= 44-66 uF considering DC bias and verify VSON-14 layout guidelines in the official TI datasheet before production.
